desc:
🕳️ BLACK HOLE SURVIVAL

Think you can survive a black hole?

Run, hide, and try not to get sucked in as black holes destroy everything around you. Each round brings a new disaster, and your only goal is to stay alive.

Survive deadly black holes

Explore different maps

Watch everything get pulled into the void

Be the last one standing

How long can you survive?

👍 Like the game if you enjoy it!
